fuel.title: Fuel / Carburante
fuel.description: Product to report. Accepts friendly aliases (diesel, sp95, glp...) or the official name.

provinces.title: Provinces / Provincias
provinces.description: Filter by province name, accent-insensitive partial match. Empty = all Spain.

municipalities.title: Municipalities / Municipios
municipalities.description: Filter by municipality or town name (partial match).

brands.title: Brands / Rotulos
brands.description: Filter by brand, e.g. REPSOL, CEPSA, BALLENOIL, CARREFOUR.

latitude.title: Latitude / Latitud
latitude.description: Centre point for the radius search (WGS84).

longitude.title: Longitude / Longitud
longitude.description: Centre point for the radius search (WGS84).

radiusKm.title: Radius in km / Radio en km
radiusKm.description: Only stations within this distance of latitude/longitude.

maxPrice.title: Price alert threshold / Umbral de alerta
maxPrice.description: Stations at or below this EUR/litre are flagged belowThreshold and trigger the alert webhook.

topN.title: Cheapest N per zone / N mas baratas por zona
topN.description: 0 = every match. Otherwise keep only the N cheapest per the zone chosen in rankBy.

rankBy.title: Ranking scope / Ambito del ranking
rankBy.description: Where the cheapest-N ranking is computed: inside each province, inside each municipality, nationwide, or no ranking at all.

openNow.title: Only open right now / Solo abiertas ahora
openNow.description: Parses the official opening-hours string. Stations with an unreadable schedule are kept.

publicOnly.title: Public stations only / Solo venta al publico

includeAllFuels.title: Include every fuel price / Incluir todos los precios
includeAllFuels.description: Adds the full prices{} object per station, not only the selected fuel.

storeHistory.title: Build daily history / Guardar historico diario
storeHistory.description: Appends one row per station/day to the named dataset and computes priceChange vs the previous run.

alertWebhookUrl.title: Alert webhook URL
alertWebhookUrl.description: Optional. Receives a POST with the stations below maxPrice.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Hard cap on dataset rows. 0 = no cap.
